icons.label: Female anatomy · Half-transparent
icons.description: Full-body anterior female anatomical mannequin divided at the median plane, with an intact external half and a transparent half exposing the brain, skeleton, major muscles, vessels, thoracoabdominal organs, urinary tract, uterus, ovary, and uterine tube.
icons.designBasis: A vertical split preserves the relationship between surface anatomy and internal position while sex-specific pelvic anatomy is shown without labels or explicit external detail.

icons.label: Male anatomy · Half-transparent
icons.description: Full-body anterior male anatomical mannequin divided at the median plane, with an intact external half and a transparent half exposing the brain, skeleton, major muscles, vessels, thoracoabdominal organs, urinary tract, prostate, and simplified internal reproductive tract.
icons.designBasis: The shared pose and split direction support direct comparison with the female figure while retaining male pelvic anatomy and neutral publication-oriented presentation.
